sentences.zh: 我这么说并不是贬义，因为我认为《迷失》是过去几十年里最伟大的剧集之一。

sentences.en: But there is this part of it, which is like, all right, what is Lumen doing?
sentences.zh: 但它有一部分内容是这样的：好吧，宏润公司到底在搞什么鬼？

sentences.en: What are the GOATs?
sentences.zh: 那些核心人物都是谁？

sentences.en: Who, why are there only four, seemingly four people working at this company, you know, in charge?
sentences.zh: 为什么，为什么这家公司里似乎只有四个人，你知道的，负责管理？

sentences.en: I think I empathize, and I also felt that.
sentences.zh: 我想我能感同身受，我当时也有这种感觉。

sentences.en: But I also, at some point, I realized, oh, this isn't, the strength of it isn't the mystery.
sentences.zh: 但同时，在某一刻我意识到，哦，这并不是，它的强项不在于神秘感。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Like, I think, you know, like Alexis is saying, like, it has moment to moment all these incredible jewels.
sentences.zh: 就像，我认为，就像亚历克西斯说的，它在每个时刻都有这些令人惊叹的亮点。

sentences.en: I mean, the relationship between Christopher Walken and John Turturro is beautifully realized.
sentences.zh: 我是说，克里斯托弗·沃肯和约翰·特托罗之间的关系表现得极其细腻。

sentences.en: Zach Cherry is showing incredible range.
sentences.zh: 扎克·切里展现出了惊人的戏路。

sentences.en: That's a fascinating relationship with Merritt Weaver.
sentences.zh: 那与梅里特·韦弗的关系非常引人入胜。

sentences.en: The language of it is incredibly ornate and interesting.
sentences.zh: 剧中的台词极其华丽且引人入胜。

sentences.en: But fundamentally, I think, like, it's not a show where plot is its strength.
sentences.zh: 但从根本上讲，我认为，这不是一部以情节见长的剧集。

sentences.en: And increasingly, the way that we're taught to watch these shows is as in trying to solve a mystery of the plot.
sentences.zh: 而且越来越严重的是，我们被教导观看这些剧集的方式，就像是在试图解开情节的谜团。

sentences.en: You know, we're not living in a golden age of TV, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们并不是生活在电视的黄金时代，对吧？

sentences.en: We're, as our TV critic pointed out, we're in a mid-era of TV.
sentences.zh: 正如我们的电视评论员所指出的，我们正处于电视的中期时代。

sentences.en: But if you were to make a case that we are, if you were to try to, to strain it, I think you'd have to start here because it's, what it's attempting to do is so ambitious.
sentences.zh: 但如果你要证明我们是，如果你想牵强附会地证明，我想你必须从这里开始，因为它的尝试是如此雄心勃勃。

sentences.en: And if you look at really great art, plot is important, but it's not, certainly not what you would describe as the most important aspect of most great art.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看真正伟大的艺术，情节很重要，但它绝不是你所能形容的大多数伟大艺术中最核心的要素。

sentences.en: And I think at some point it became less interested in plot and the mystery of it than in some of these ideas, which are actually quite dark ideas.
sentences.zh: 我想在某个时候，它对情节和神秘感的兴趣降低了，转而关注其中一些其实相当黑暗的理念。

sentences.en: I mean, it's about, it turns into a show, in my view, about slavery, you know, about whether these innies are, are they people?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在看来，它变成了一部关于奴隶制的剧集，你知道的，关于这些分身是，他们是人吗？

sentences.en: Are they worthy of love?
sentences.zh: 他们配得上爱吗？

sentences.en: Are they worthy of life?
sentences.zh: 他们配得上生命吗？

sentences.en: Or are they just means to an end?
sentences.zh: 还是他们只是达到目的的手段？

sentences.en: I think it's fascinating, too, because there's a show, it's sort of created by a gentleman named Dan Erickson,
sentences.zh: 我也觉得这很迷人，因为这部剧是由一位名叫丹·埃里克森的绅士创作的，

sentences.en: but it is produced and many of the episodes are directed by someone who we used to consider one of the great comic actors, Ben Stiller,
sentences.zh: 但它是由我们曾经认为的伟大喜剧演员之一本·斯蒂勒制片并导演了许多集，

sentences.en: who has become someone now who I feel like has moved into this phase where this, this sort of is, is his life now, as opposed to, to being a comedic actor.
sentences.zh: 他现在似乎已经进入了这样的人生阶段，这成了他的生活重心，而不是去当一名喜剧演员。

sentences.en: It's true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And you, I sort of, you forget it.
sentences.zh: 而且你，我有点，你会忘记这一点。

sentences.en: If it doesn't feel like a bed, that every once in a while something will happen where you're like, oh yeah, there's a comedian behind this.
sentences.zh: 如果它感觉不像个框架，偶尔会发生一些事情让你觉得，哦对，幕后有个喜剧演员。

sentences.en: And I do think that's the magic trick of the show, is that the tone, you know, is, it's paranoid.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为那是这部剧的魔术把戏，它的基调，你知道的，充满了偏执。

sentences.en: It's kind of unlike anything else on TV, I would say.
sentences.zh: 我想说，它和电视上的任何其他节目都不太一样。

sentences.en: It really is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Like the flavor is unlike anything else.
sentences.zh: 那种风味是独一无二的。

sentences.en: And it could, it, I mean, it is a dark show and it is a dour show in its way, but it could be so much darker and so much more dour.
sentences.zh: 它可能，我是说，从某种程度上讲，这是一部黑暗且沉闷的剧集，但它可以变得更加黑暗、更加沉闷。

sentences.en: And there are moments of pure absurdism that really leaven it and make it feel like nothing else.
sentences.zh: 其中有一些纯粹荒诞的时刻，真正缓和了气氛，让它显得独一无二。

sentences.en: I would like to believe, and I don't know if this is true, but I would like to believe that it is strong enough that if the central mysteries were solved,
sentences.zh: 我愿意相信，我不知道这是否属实，但我愿意相信它的底蕴足够深厚，即使核心的谜团被解开，

sentences.en: if the questions were answered, if we suddenly knew everything about Lumen Industries and what Lumen Industries was doing,
sentences.zh: 如果这些问题得到了解答，如果我们突然知道了关于宏润工业的一切以及宏润工业在做什么，

sentences.en: that there would still be enough for the show to persevere.
sentences.zh: 这部剧依然有足够的内涵支撑下去。

sentences.en: That this is just a carapace and maybe a carapace that it doesn't really need anymore.
sentences.zh: 这只是一个外壳，也许是一个它已经不再真正需要的外壳。

sentences.en: Well, another element, you're right.
sentences.zh: 好吧，还有一个元素，你说得对。

sentences.en: I think it also becomes like a romance in which...
sentences.zh: 我觉得它也变成了一部浪漫剧，其中……

sentences.en: There's a love triangle.
sentences.zh: 有一个三角恋。

sentences.en: There's a love triangle in which he has to choose at the end.
sentences.zh: 有一个三角恋，他最后必须做出选择。

sentences.en: Because he has two selves, so it's like a love quadrilateral.
sentences.zh: 因为他有两个自我，所以这就像是一场四角恋。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 对，没错。

sentences.en: And then, you know, he chooses and he doesn't, and then there's like this Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid, you know, freeze frame.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道的，他做了选择又没选，接着就像《虎豹小霸王》里那样，你知道的，画面定格。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: The last minute of this season is quite striking and memorable, both in musical choice and imagery.
sentences.zh: 这一季的最后关头非常引人注目且令人难忘，无论是在音乐选择还是意象上。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes, the velvet fog returns.
sentences.zh: 是的，绒面雾回归了。

sentences.en: It's like The Graduate before they get on the bus.
sentences.zh: 就像他们上车前的《毕业生》。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: We are going to keep surfing.
sentences.zh: 我们将继续冲浪。

sentences.en: Let's move on to our next show, gang.
sentences.zh: 大家，我们进入下一个节目吧。

sentences.en: We were on!
sentences.zh: 我们上了！

sentences.en: Kim, would you stop taking pictures of yourself?
sentences.zh: 金，你能不能别老拍自己了？

sentences.en: Your sister's going to jail.
sentences.zh: 你妹妹都要坐牢了。

sentences.en: Who did you meet with a boat?
sentences.zh: 你见到的那个开船的是谁？

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: Are they decent people?
sentences.zh: 他们是正经人吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, they own their own yacht.
sentences.zh: 对，他们有自己的游艇。

sentences.en: They're rich.
sentences.zh: 他们很有钱。

sentences.en: Just because people are rich doesn't mean they're not trashy.
sentences.zh: 有钱并不代表他们不低俗。

sentences.en: Most rich people are trashy.
sentences.zh: 大多数有钱人都很低俗。

sentences.en: I wouldn't go that far.
sentences.zh: 我可不会说得那么绝对。

sentences.en: That accent can only be from one show.
sentences.zh: 这种口音只能出自一部剧。

sentences.en: We've changed the channel back to HBO.
sentences.zh: 我们把频道切回了HBO。

sentences.en: We're talking about The White Lotus.
sentences.zh: 我们正在聊《白莲花度假村》。

sentences.en: This is the third season of the Mike White drama, in which essentially rich people go to a fancy resort somewhere, all owned by the White Lotus chain, and then someone dies.
sentences.zh: 这是迈克·怀特执导的剧情片的第三季，基本上讲的是有钱人去某个属于白莲花连锁的高档度假村，然后有人死了。

sentences.en: First one, Hawaii.
sentences.zh: 第一季，夏威夷。

sentences.en: Second one, Sicily.
sentences.zh: 第二季，西西里。

sentences.en: Next season's going to be in France, but this one was set in Thailand.
sentences.zh: 下一季将在法国拍摄，但这一季背景设在泰国。

sentences.en: Alexis, I don't watch this show.
sentences.zh: 亚历克西斯，我不看这部剧。

sentences.en: I've never wanted to start.
sentences.zh: 我从来没想过开始看。

sentences.en: I don't think I ever will.
sentences.zh: 我想我永远也不会看。

sentences.en: How do you—what do you do at—oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 你怎么——你在——哦，天哪。

sentences.en: At cocktail parties, do you talk about books?
sentences.zh: 在鸡尾酒会上，你们是聊书吗？

sentences.en: Jesus.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Yeah, and I can't find anyone to actually engage with me.
sentences.zh: 对啊，而且我都找不到人来真正跟我交流。

sentences.en: How do you participate in the life of the culture?
sentences.zh: 你怎么参与文化生活？

sentences.en: I have to serve.
sentences.zh: 我只能硬着头皮应付。

sentences.en: I think I'd just say, have you seen The Bear?
sentences.zh: 我想我会直接说，你看过《熊家餐馆》吗？

sentences.en: That show's great.
sentences.zh: 那部剧真棒。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: Yeah, The Bear.
sentences.zh: 对，还有《熊家餐馆》。

sentences.en: Talk about The White Lotus.
sentences.zh: 聊聊《白莲花度假村》吧。

sentences.en: I love a show that understands the assignment.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一部真正懂自己任务的剧。

sentences.en: I love a show that understands that the job of TV—TV has many jobs, but I would say the really big one is to entertain,
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一部深知电视职责的剧——电视有很多职责，但我想最重要的一点绝对是娱乐大众，

sentences.en: and that knows that what we want to see are beautiful people in a gorgeous location being miserable.
sentences.zh: 并且它知道我们想看的是长相标志的人在风景绝佳的地方饱受痛苦。

sentences.en: So it is all the wealth porn and all the schadenfreude rolled into one, and because Mike White and his casting directors are very savvy,
sentences.zh: 所以它把所有的财富色情片和幸灾乐祸完美融合，而且因为迈克·怀特和他的选角导演非常精明，

sentences.en: they get some of the greatest working actors to populate these shows.
sentences.zh: 他们找来了一些最优秀的演员来出演这些剧。

sentences.en: And so it has mystery, it has excitement, it has sex, it has me imagining what my life would be like if I, too, could afford room service.
sentences.zh: 所以它有悬疑，有刺激，有性，还有我幻想着如果我也能付得起客房送餐服务，我的生活会是什么样。

sentences.en: It has it all.
sentences.zh: 它应有尽有。

sentences.en: It delivers.
sentences.zh: 它没有让人失望。

sentences.en: What—why do you think, other than wealth porn, schadenfreude, when you talk to your friends about this show, what is— You want more?
sentences.zh: 你为什么——除了财富色情、幸灾乐祸，当你和朋友聊起这部剧时，还有什么——你还想要更多吗？

sentences.en: Do you want more than that?
sentences.zh: 难道你还嫌不够？

sentences.en: I'm not sold yet.
sentences.zh: 我还没被说服。

sentences.en: Tell me.
sentences.zh: 告诉我。

sentences.en: I need you to sell me, but in the Parker Posey accent.
sentences.zh: 你需要说服我，但得用帕克·波西的口音。

sentences.en: What do you—yes.
sentences.zh: 你觉得——没错。

sentences.en: And, you know, when you said this could only be one show, I think it could actually be two shows.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，当你刚才说这只能是一部剧时，我觉得它其实可以算两部剧。

sentences.en: One is The White Lotus, and one is an unusually demented episode of Southern Charm.
sentences.zh: 一部是《白莲花度假村》，另一部是《南方魅力》里极其变态的一集。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: But I think it has everything, and I don't think you need to think too hard.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得它应有尽有，而且你不需要思考太多。

sentences.en: I think it has these incredibly beautiful locations, this evocation of luxury.
sentences.zh: 我觉得它有美得令人窒息的场景，这种奢华的氛围感。

sentences.en: I think it has wonderful actors.
sentences.zh: 我觉得它有极佳的演员。

sentences.en: In every season, something really terrible and awkward happens on a boat.
sentences.zh: 每一季，总会在船上发生一些极其糟糕和尴尬的事。

sentences.en: So, if—I mean, you need more than this.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果——我是说，如果你觉得这还不够。

sentences.en: I get that.
sentences.zh: 我懂。

sentences.en: But I do feel like this season got some mixed notices, as they say.
sentences.zh: 但我确实觉得这一季收获了一些所谓的褒贬不一的评价。

sentences.en: I think it did.
sentences.zh: 我想确实如此。

sentences.en: I think this season did feel sometimes like it was repeating beats of the previous seasons, which you could say suggests a show that's out of ideas.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这一季有时确实给人一种在重复前几季套路的感觉，这可以说是这部剧江郎才尽的信号。

sentences.en: I like to liken it to the Buddhist concept of samsara, right?
sentences.zh: 我喜欢把它比作佛教中的“轮回”概念，对吧？

sentences.en: Remind us what that is again.
sentences.zh: 提醒我们那是什么来着。

sentences.en: You don't know?
sentences.zh: 你不知道？

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 对，对，对。

sentences.en: I do, but I just want to sell the Buddhist or the BuddhiSt.
sentences.zh: 我知道，但我只是想推销一下佛教或……

sentences.en: I want to be on the same page here.
sentences.zh: 我想和大家的频道保持一致。

sentences.en: How do you—I know.
sentences.zh: 你怎么——我知道。

sentences.en: Just this idea that, you know, we are in a constant cycle of death and rebirth, and that we are always going to work out the same tensions, the same conflicts, the same desires,
sentences.zh: 就是这种理念，你知道的，我们处于生死轮回的无尽循环中，我们总会去解决相同的张力、相同的冲突、相同的欲望，

sentences.en: that that is at the core of our humanity.
sentences.zh: 这正是我们人性的核心。

sentences.en: So, and I also think that television does benefit somewhat from the familiar.
sentences.zh: 所以，而且我也认为电视在一定程度上确实能从熟悉感中受益。

sentences.en: I do enjoy a procedural.
sentences.zh: 我确实很喜欢罪案剧。

sentences.en: I do enjoy the comforts of a procedural.
sentences.zh: 我确实很享受罪案剧带来的舒适感。

sentences.en: And I would not necessarily call White Lotus a comfortable show because there is a lot of cringe.
sentences.zh: 但我不会把《白莲花度假村》称为一部让人感到舒适的剧，因为里面有太多令人脚趾抠地的尴尬情节了。

sentences.en: There was, like, a semi-incest plot line this season that I absolutely had to watch through my fingers.
sentences.zh: 这季有个类似于近亲乱伦的情节，我看得简直得从手指缝里偷看。

sentences.en: But I do think that there is something comforting in seeing a writer-director at the top of his game do what he does, which has always been, if you're Mike White,
sentences.zh: 不过我的确觉得，看到一个正处于巅峰期的编剧兼导演做他擅长的事，有一种莫名的慰藉，如果你了解迈克·怀特的话，

sentences.en: to display humans at their most venal.
sentences.zh: 那就是展现人性中最唯利是图的一面。

sentences.en: Most people don't have good values.
sentences.zh: 大多数人的价值观都不怎么样。

sentences.en: They're scammers.
sentences.zh: 他们都是骗子。

sentences.en: You're all gorgeous, and you come for money.
sentences.zh: 你们个个光彩照人，而你们是为了钱而来的。

sentences.en: So, you have to be hyper-vigilant, okay?
sentences.zh: 所以，你们必须高度警惕，好吗？

sentences.en: You have to be on your guard.
sentences.zh: 你们必须保持防备。

sentences.en: Let me ask you if you agree.
sentences.zh: 让我问问你们是否同意。

sentences.en: I sort of have—there's so many of these shows about rich people behaving badly that are intended for us to dislike them.
sentences.zh: 我有点——有太多这种关于富人行为恶劣的剧了，它们的目的就是让我们讨厌他们。

sentences.en: And I—you know, there's a thing that people say, or a theory about war movies, that there's no such thing as an anti-war movie.
sentences.zh: 而且我——你知道，人们常说，或者关于战争电影有个理论，那就是根本没有所谓的反战电影。

sentences.en: That if you put war on screen, it's inevitably going to come off glamorous, and it's going to romanticize violence.
sentences.zh: 如果你把战争搬上银幕，它不可避免地就会显得光鲜亮丽，从而把暴力浪漫化。

sentences.en: And I've kind of grown to feel like that's true of rich people, movies, and television shows, of which this is not an insignificant part of our cultural diet.
sentences.zh: 我渐渐觉得，富人、电影和电视剧也是如此，而这在我们日常的文化食粮中占了相当大的比重。

sentences.en: Succession, most famously.
sentences.zh: 《继承之战》就是最著名的例子。

sentences.en: I don't care how much they make us want to think that being insanely wealthy looks bad.
sentences.zh: 我才不在乎它们多想让我们觉得含着金汤匙出生看起来有多糟糕。

sentences.en: It still looks pretty good.
sentences.zh: 它看起来还是挺不错的。

sentences.en: I would like to try it.
sentences.zh: 我还挺想试试的。

sentences.en: I think that the secret to these shows is the feeling that you have, even if you don't express it, which is, I would do better.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这些剧的秘诀在于那种感觉，即使你没有表达出来，那就是：我要是上的话，能做得更好。

sentences.en: If I were in this gorgeous hotel, in this gorgeous location, I would behave appropriately.
sentences.zh: 如果我在这个豪华的酒店里，在这个豪华的地方，我就会表现得体。

sentences.en: You know, everyone thinks they'll be a better rich person.
sentences.zh: 你知道，每个人都觉得自己会是个更好的有钱人。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 是吗？

sentences.en: Do you?
sentences.zh: 你觉得呢？

sentences.en: I'm Gilbert Cruz, and I'm here with Jason Zinneman and Alexis Salosky.
sentences.zh: 我是吉尔伯特·克鲁兹，我和杰森·齐内曼以及亚历克西斯·萨洛斯基在这里。

sentences.en: On this Emmys Day, we're talking about some of our favorite TV from the past year.
sentences.zh: 在这个艾美奖颁奖日，我们来聊聊过去一年里我们最喜欢的一些电视剧。

sentences.en: Let us go to our next show, Channel Change, now.
sentences.zh: 现在，让我们来看看下一部剧《换台》。

sentences.en: I couldn't help but wonder—
sentences.zh: 我不禁在想——

sentences.en: Did I do that?
sentences.zh: 是我干的吗？

sentences.en: You start packing yet?
sentences.zh: 你开始收拾行李了吗？

sentences.en: Oh, no, but I will.
sentences.zh: 哦，还没，但我会收拾的。

sentences.en: Oh, you want some help?
sentences.zh: 哦，你想让人帮忙吗？

sentences.en: From who?
sentences.zh: 谁？

sentences.en: You?
sentences.zh: 你？

sentences.zh: 对，我。

sentences.en: Come on.
sentences.zh: 得了吧。

sentences.en: Well, because you hate packing.
sentences.zh: 好吧，因为你讨厌收拾行李。

sentences.en: Everybody hates packing's all the—you know, we do the things that we hate for the ones we love.
sentences.zh: 所有人都不喜欢收拾行李，大家都是——你知道的，我们为了所爱的人去做那些我们讨厌的事。

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh, are you being tender with me?
sentences.zh: 哦天哪，你是在对我展现温柔吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I like it.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这样。

sentences.en: So this is Somebody Somewhere, which aired its third and final season.
sentences.zh: 这就是《某人某地》，它播出了第三季也是最后一季。

sentences.en: This is about a woman, played by Bridget Everett, who moves back to her Midwestern hometown and finds a bunch of friends, a bunch of outsiders that she falls in with.
sentences.zh: 讲的是一个由布里奇特·埃弗雷特饰演的女人，她搬回中西部的家乡，结识了一群朋友，一群她融入进去的局外人。

sentences.en: And it's sort of like a warm show.
sentences.zh: 这是一部挺温馨的剧。

sentences.en: Both of you like this.
sentences.zh: 你们两个都喜欢这部剧。

sentences.en: I love this show.
sentences.zh: 我太爱这部剧了。

sentences.en: This is a show that breaks my heart and then puts it back together with a Band-Aid and a kiss.
sentences.zh: 这部剧总是把我的心揉碎，然后用一张创可贴和一个吻把它重新拼好。

sentences.en: This—I felt so many feelings just in that little clip that you played.
sentences.zh: 这——光是刚才播放的那小段剪辑，就让我涌现出无数的情感。

sentences.en: All I want are shows about people being kind to each other and learning to grow and be better in incremental ways.
sentences.zh: 我想要的只是那些关于人们彼此友善、学会成长并在点滴中变得更好的剧。

sentences.en: Like, this is what I love, and this does it so well.
sentences.zh: 真的，这就是我所爱，而这部剧把这点做得太棒了。

sentences.en: And if you have ever seen Bridget Everett onstage, she is an alt-cabaret performer.
sentences.zh: 如果你看过布里奇特·埃弗雷特在台上的表演，她是一个另类歌舞表演者。

sentences.en: She is dynamic.
sentences.zh: 她充满活力。

sentences.en: She is exciting.
sentences.zh: 她令人兴奋。

sentences.en: She is sumptuous.
sentences.zh: 她雍容华贵。

sentences.en: She is over-the-top.
sentences.zh: 她夸张至极。

sentences.en: And all of that too-muchness and over-the-topness, she has restrained into playing a very real character.
sentences.zh: 而她把所有这些过分和夸张，收敛起来去饰演一个非常真实的角色的。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, I can't think of a half-hour show, comedy or otherwise, that's made me cry more than this show.
sentences.zh: 对，我是说，我想不出来还有哪部半小时的喜剧或其他类型的剧，能比这部剧更能让我落泪的了。

sentences.en: Now, I don't know—and it's something I thought, why am I always crying at this show?
sentences.zh: 现在，我不知道——而且我一直在想，为什么我总是看这部剧看到哭？

sentences.en: But I think there's a couple theories.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得有几种解释。

sentences.en: One is the use of music.
sentences.zh: 其中之一是对音乐的运用。

sentences.en: Music is the most emotional of art forMs.
sentences.zh: 音乐是艺术中最具情感张力的形式。

sentences.en: And as Alexis points out, you know, Bridget Everett is a singer, and they strategically use—she has this incredible gift.
sentences.zh: 正如亚历克西斯所指出的，你知道，布里奇特·埃弗雷特是个歌手，他们巧妙地运用了——她拥有这种不可思议的天赋。

sentences.en: A cup of coffee I'll take forever
sentences.zh: 一杯咖啡我能喝到地老天荒

sentences.en: And then I'll take some more
sentences.zh: 然后我还要再来点

sentences.en: And not just her, but there's a couple other, you know, sort of strategic songs in the show, which are heartbreaking.
sentences.zh: 不仅是她，剧中还有其他几首，你知道的，具有战略意义的歌曲，它们令人心碎。

sentences.en: Second of all, I think so much of entertainment is these high-stakes stories about fighting aliens or, you know, doctors saving lives or billionaires fighting people.
sentences.zh: 其次，我觉得大部分娱乐作品都是那种高风险的故事，比如打外星人，或者，你知道的，医生拯救生命，或者亿万富翁勾心斗角。

sentences.en: So, uh, it almost feels radical to see a carefully observed portrait of ordinary people, working-class people in the Midwest trying to make connections.
sentences.zh: 所以，呃，看到一幅对中西部普通人、工人阶级试图建立联系的细腻观察肖像，几乎感觉有点激进。

sentences.en: Because, oh!
sentences.zh: 因为，哦！

sentences.en: Um, and it's funny—it's a funny—it's an irony of the show that it's this middle-American portrait, because it's made by all these downtown New York theater people.
sentences.zh: 嗯，而且很有趣——这部剧的一个讽刺之处在于，它展现的是美国中西部的画卷，因为它是这群纽约市中心的戏剧人制作的。

sentences.en: And Bridget Everett and Jeff Keller get a lot of credit, as they should.
sentences.zh: 布里奇特·埃弗雷特和杰夫·希勒功不可没，他们当之无愧。

sentences.en: They're the kind of friendship that's at the core of this show.
sentences.zh: 他们是这部剧核心的那种友谊。

sentences.en: But the—the writers and creators of the show ran a off-Broadway theater company called Debate Society that really put on these jewel-like productions.
sentences.zh: 但是，这部剧的编剧和创作者曾经营过一家名为“辩论社”的外百老汇戏剧公司，他们真的制作了这些如珠宝般精致的作品。

sentences.en: And they, you know, they were also—a lot of them were set in the MidweSt.
sentences.zh: 而且他们，你知道，他们也——他们很多作品的背景都在中西部。

sentences.en: They—and what they—I would describe them as being very fully realized, very detailed.
sentences.zh: 他们——我会把他们作品的特点描述为极其丰满、极其细腻。

sentences.en: Um, so every choice felt like an incredible amount of thought came into it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以每一个选择都让人觉得融入了难以置信的心思。

sentences.en: Every character felt like they had a considered backstory.
sentences.zh: 每一个角色都让人觉得有着深思熟虑的背景故事。

sentences.en: It felt very lived in.
sentences.zh: 感觉非常具有生活气息。

sentences.en: Uh, at the same time, there was something a little Lynchian about these shows.
sentences.zh: 呃，与此同时，这些剧里又带有一点大卫·林奇式的风格。

sentences.en: And so what they did here is they took out the kind of Lynchian aspect to it and put in this—this realism anchored by—as Alexis points out, this understated performance by, um,
sentences.zh: 所以他们在这里所做的，是去掉了那种大卫·林奇式的元素，加入了这种——正如亚历克西斯所指出的，由呃……

sentences.en: Bridget Everett.
sentences.zh: 布里奇特·埃弗雷特那种内敛的表演所锚定的现实主义。

sentences.en: And there's a—a real power in this marriage, um, particularly if—I think one thing that's always emotional is when these larger-than-life characters go small.
sentences.zh: 这种默契中有一种真正的力量，呃，特别是如果——我认为有一件总是让人情绪激动的事，那就是当这些顶天立地的角色变得卑微时。

sentences.en: Um, you know, when you see, um, the tenderness of, you know, uh, Marlon Brando and The Godfather at the end—at the end of The Godfather, that makes our people cry.
sentences.zh: 呃，你知道的，当你看到，呃，马龙·白兰度和《教父》在结尾时的那种温柔——在《教父》结尾时，这让我们这些凡人落泪。

sentences.en: Uh, when—and there's something similar about, uh, Bridget Everett's performance, that she's this powerhouse, but she's constantly, uh, making herself small in a way that—that is—
sentences.zh: 呃，当——布里奇特·埃弗雷特的表演也有类似之处，她是个实力派，但她一直在，呃，刻意让自己显得卑微，以一种——

sentences.en: very recognizable.
sentences.zh: 非常具有辨识度的方式。

sentences.en: And it's really not what you feel, at least what I feel.
sentences.zh: 这真的和你感受到的不同，至少和我感受到的不同。

sentences.en: When I see Bridget Everett doing cabaret show, you think this is this sort of superhero-like person.
sentences.zh: 当你看到布里奇特·埃弗雷特表演歌舞秀时，你会觉得这是一种超级英雄般的人物。

sentences.en: But she really is playing against it in a quite, uh, heartbreaking way.
sentences.zh: 但她其实是在反其道而行之，以一种相当、呃，令人心碎的方式演绎。

sentences.en: It's so particular.
sentences.zh: 它是如此独特。

sentences.en: It's so beautifully observed.
sentences.zh: 它是如此细腻入微。

sentences.en: It has been ignored by the Emmys until now.
sentences.zh: 它一直被艾美奖忽视直到现在。

sentences.en: And this year, finally, it has two nominations.
sentences.zh: 而今年，它终于获得了两个提名。

sentences.en: One from Jeff Hiller, who is extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 其中一个来自杰夫·希勒，他太卓越了。

sentences.en: And then one, I think, really, really deserved for outstanding writing.
sentences.zh: 然后其中有一部，我觉得真的是实至名归，剧本写得太棒了。

sentences.en: Because the writing really is outstanding.
sentences.zh: 因为剧本确实非常出色。

sentences.en: And I'm so pleased to see it recognized.
sentences.zh: 而且我很高兴看到它得到认可。

sentences.en: But I think there was a moment in the 2010s where studios, network streamers, were putting their money a little bit behind these sort of smaller,
sentences.zh: 但我觉得在2010年代的某个时期，电影公司和网络流媒体曾把资金稍微投入到这种规模较小、

sentences.en: voicey comedies that felt really lovely and really particular.
sentences.zh: 充满个人特色、感觉非常可爱且十分独特的喜剧中。

sentences.en: And we've moved away from that.
sentences.zh: 而我们现在已经远离了那种风格。

sentences.en: And the fact that somebody somewhere was allowed to exist, that it was given three seasons.
sentences.zh: 而且，某个地方的某部作品能够获得生存的机会，甚至续订了三季。

sentences.en: What a gift.
sentences.zh: 这真是一份厚礼。

sentences.en: What a joy.
sentences.zh: 这真是一大快乐。

sentences.en: Yep, yep, yep.
sentences.zh: 没错，没错，没错。

sentences.en: Well, listening to music, Jason, and watching TV and watching movies are really the only way that I can cry these days.
sentences.zh: 嗯，听音乐，杰森，还有看电视和看电影，真的是我如今仅有的能让我哭出来的方式了。

sentences.en: So, uh, I think I need to watch somebody somewhere.
sentences.zh: 所以，呃，我想我需要去看这部剧了。

sentences.zh: 我们要换频道了。

sentences.zh: 你用想象力的钥匙开启了这扇大门。

sentences.en: You come at the king, you best not miss.
sentences.zh: 你要是冲着国王来，最好别失手。

sentences.en: You know, prestige films and box office hits, those are not mutually exclusive.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，大片和票房热门并不排斥彼此。

sentences.en: We can do both and we will do both.
sentences.zh: 我们能两样都做，也确实会两样都做。

sentences.en: And that is why I am excited to announce that we are fast-tracking a Kool-Aid movie.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我很高兴地宣布，我们正在加急筹备一部酷爱饮品大电影。

sentences.en: Oh yeah, this is the studio.
sentences.zh: 哦耶，这就是这家制片厂。

sentences.en: This is a show that all three of us watched.
sentences.zh: 这是一部我们三个人都看过的剧。

sentences.en: Uh, it's an Apple TV Plus show.
sentences.zh: 呃，这是一部Apple TV+的剧。

sentences.en: It's co-created by, and it stars Seth Rogen.
